Vivid dreaming predominantly occurs during Rapid Eye Movement (REM) sleep, a phase characterized by high brain activity and muscular paralysis. Clearwater Beach is located on the barrier island of Clearwater, Florida, along the Gulf of Mexico. Smartphones utilize rechargeable lithium-ion battery cells managed by specialized battery management integrated circuits. The Milky Way is a barred spiral galaxy with a diameter estimated between 100,000 and 180,000 light-years. Astronomers estimate that the galaxy contains between 100 billion and 400 billion stars. Coca-Cola was formulated in 1886 by Atlanta pharmacist John Stith Pemberton as a patent medicine syrup. Although basic ingredients like carbonated water, sugar, phosphoric acid, and caffeine are listed, the exact combination of essential flavoring oils remains proprietary.

Human sleep schedules are regulated by biological circadian rhythms as well as social obligations like employment or school routines. Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level, reaching an elevation of 29,031.7 feet (8,848.86 meters) in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.
